description: Read the branch-protection rule that applies to a branch (exact name or the glob that covers it): required checks, require_pr_run, required approvals, AI / human review, green gates, force-push / deletion, auto-merge. Read-only. Returns {protected: false} when no rule applies, else {protected: true, pattern, matched_by, required_checks, …}.

branch.description: Branch name (default: the repo's default branch)

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_get_branch_protection
